mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_user_account (user_id, tenant_id, org_id, username, email, phone, password_hash, enabled, status, last_login, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{orgId}, #{username}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{enabled}, #{status}, #{lastLogin}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM iam_user_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, tenant_id, org_id, username, email, phone, password_hash, enabled, status, last_login, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_user_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at
